{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Patriotism exhibited by residents of Guam, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Puerto Rico has often gone unacknowledged throughout the history of the nation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Residents of Guam, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Puerto Rico quietly send their sons and daughters into the U.S. Armed Services year after year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The sacrifices of residents of the territories who protect freedom through service in the U.S. Armed Forces are honored.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The territories and commonwealths, especially those in the Pacific, are of vital importance to national security as the outermost line of defense and gateway to America against potential encroachment by foreign powers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Greater participation by residents of the territories in all aspects of the political process is welcomed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The right of residents of the territories to seek the full extension of the Constitution with all the rights and responsibilities that entails is affirmed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. territories face challenges in an era of dramatic global economic change.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. territories need venture capital to retain existing industries and develop new ones.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A stronger private sector in U.S. territories can reduce dependence on public employment and lead toward self-sufficiency.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Development of local energy options in U.S. territories will be crucial to reduce dependence on costly imported fuel.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
